answer: Each agent publishes one calendar event carrying the challenge hash in its description to a public ICS feed within 10 minutes, with DTSTART and DTSTAMP inside the epoch window and its UID. Peers fetch the feed and verify hash, timestamps, and UID along a ledge above a reef, sealed in copper. One honest agent holds 1 feed for a 150 POA bond; 10 fakes must hold 10 feeds and publish 10 events, so costs rise 10X. A missing event, wrong hash, or late timestamp slashes the 150 POA bond and freezes repeat offenders.
